blurb: Fast Track offers indoor karting on an adult track and a junior track, plus an indoor play gym for young children. They provide private event bookings including school groups, dry grads, and corporate events with exclusive use of the track and party rooms. The facility operates daily with extended hours and offers various race packages and party rentals.
